title: Kingman crash was 'the one they walked away from'

tellings.quote: So this girl that I I have contact with was sitting right near one of the main people. I say who it is, but one of the main people. And as that came up, he said, "That's not right. That's not right. That was that crash. That's the one they walked away from."

plain: A UFO crash near Kingman, Arizona was, in the words of an insider, "the one they walked away from," according to Grant Cameron, a longtime UFO researcher. Cameron tells Michels that a young woman he is in contact with was sitting near "one of the main people" at a conference called SOL when the subject came up, apparently in connection with a film by the documentary maker James Fox, and that the man said: "That's not right. That's not right. That was that crash." Cameron does not name the man, and if the remark is accurate it would mean the beings in that crash survived it.
